verdict.rationale: Anthropic's docs say Claude loads skills automatically when relevant, reading the full SKILL.md once it judges a skill applies [docs-2, docs-3, docs-25]. The spec requires a description stating what the skill does and when to use it [docs-17, docs-32], and skill-creator can optimize descriptions for triggering accuracy [docs-14]. Hands-on reports concretely contradict this: users say skills don't fire on expected keywords and must be invoked explicitly even with proper YAML and semantic triggers [comm-12, comm-13], and cited Vercel evals found the skill was never invoked in 56% of cases [comm-14]. Missing for 10: reliable auto-triggering in practice, independent evidence that description optimization measurably improves activation.
